A public good utility, in pilot

One register of the whole UK state

Every public body the official registers know about, from departments and councils to NHS trusts, devolved bodies, Crown Dependencies and Overseas Territories. Each body keeps the code its own register gives it, and every join to another list shows how it was made, so you can check it.

Safe-fail reconciliation

A wrong join is worse than a missing one

Names are joined only when the cleaning steps that make them equal can't change which body is meant, or when an independent register says they are the same body. Everything else is either set aside with its reason or left for a person, with the evidence beside it.

Set aside automatically

Near-names of different bodies. They are not joined, and each shows why. If you know a pair is the same body, say so and a steward will check it.

False friends the checks guard against

Each pair below is two different bodies. Check OG-01 fails the build if any is ever joined, and a deliberate break proves the check works.

          Disclaimer

          A pilot built from open registers. It isn't an official list of government, and no body named here has endorsed it. Matches marked as inferred or provisional are the register's own reasoning, not the owning body's.

          Transparency

          Built by the Data Management Lead, Office of the Chief Data Officer, with Claude (an AI assistant) doing the harvesting, matching and page build under a person's direction. Every figure is computed from the sources listed under Quality and trust.
